 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION (FOR QUASHING & SET ASIDE  FIR/ORDER) NO. 20040 of 2021  ==========================================================
 VISHAL NANCHANDBHAI SUTHAR & ORS.
 Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MR HARNISH V DARJI(3705) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5  NOTICE SERVED for the Respondent(s) No. 2  MR SOHAM JOSHI, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE J. C. DOSHI  Date : 03/10/2025  ORAL ORDER 1.

sentences.text: Learned advocate Mr. Maulik H.Sayani states that he has instructions to appear on behalf of the original complainant and thereby, seeks permission to file his Vakalatnama, which is granted.
Heard learned advocates for the respective parties.

2. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and since it is jointly stated at the bar by learned advocates on both the sides that the dispute between the parties has been resolved amicably,
this matter is taken up for final disposal forthwith.

3. By way of this application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicants have prayed to quash and set aside the complaint being FIR No.11206062210660 of 2021 registered with Satlasana Police Station, Mehsana for the offences under Sections 376(2)(k),
376(2)(n), 498(A) and 114 of Indian Penal Code and sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(2)(va) of the Vishal Nanchandbhai Suthar vs State Of Gujarat on 3 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182430188/

sentences.text: 4. Original complainant is present in the Court and she has filed affidavit, which is taken on record.
Respondent no.2 - complainant has verified contents of the affidavit.

Relevant portion of affidavit reads as under :-
"1.

I am the original complainant of C. R. NO. I- 11206062210660 of 2021, registered with Satisana Police Station for the offences punishable under section 376(2)(k),
376(2)(n), 498-A, 323, 114 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and Section 3(1)(r),
3(1)(s), and 3(2)(va) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

entities.text: Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: I say and submit that due to hatred, anger and misunderstanding impugned complaint was filed.
I say and submit that due to intervention of family members and interveners from village and from community now dispute between myself and applicants had been settled.
I say and submit that customary divorce has also taken place, between applicant no.1- Vishal Suthar and myself.
Now the marriage solemnized on 15/03/2021 between Vishal Suthar and myself has been dissolved vide customary divorce deed dated 05/06/2024.
Now applicant no.1 and I have separated and settled in our own life.

Copy of the divorce deed dated 05/06/2024 is annexed herewith and marked as "Annexture-I".
2. The dispute between present Petitioners and my self is also settled and I have no grievance against present Petitioners.

I say and submit that impugned complaint registered as C.R. No.
1-11206062210660 of 2021, registered with Satisana Police Station, charge-sheet filed thereon, and all other consequential proceedings, are quashed and set aside, then I have no objection.
In view of above if the impugned complaint, and all consequential proceedings, may be quashed and set aside by the Hon'ble High Court of Gujarat in the interest of justice.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/20040/2021 ORDER DATED: 03/10/2025 undefined
I have received amount of Rs 25000/- towards compensation, from Social Welfare Department, State of Gujarat.
That I am ready and willing to return the said amount to social Welfare Department."

5. In view of above, in opinion of this Court, since parties have buried their dispute, to secure the ends of justice, it would be appropriate to quash and set aside the impugned FIR and all consequential proceedings initiated in pursuance thereof under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C..
6.
In the result, the application is allowed.

The impugned FIR No.11206062210660 of 2021 registered with Satlasana Police Station, Mehsana as well as all consequential proceedings initiated in pursuance thereof are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicants herein.
7. Original complainant to return amount of compensation to the State Government within four weeks from today.
